verdict.rationale: Poke docs describe poke.com/recipes as a directory of first-party and approved third-party recipes/integrations that users can browse and add, plus a separate Integrations page for connecting apps/services. This matches the power-user story of browsing and adding connectors. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the directory's breadth or UX, and no confirmation of search/filtering or ratings within the directory.
